news.headline: Earnings preview: ClearPoint Neuro expected to post a Q3 loss of 31 cents per share
news.summary: An earnings preview published two days before the October 28 report puts the consensus Q3 2026 estimate at a loss of 31 cents per share, wider than the $0.26-0.27 loss seen earlier in October. The wider estimate suggests analysts have trimmed expectations after the AMT-130 four-year setback and the cut to $48-52M FY guidance.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro to report Q3 2026 results on October 28
news.summary: ClearPoint will release third-quarter 2026 results after the market close on Wednesday, October 28, with a webcast and conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET. It is the first print since the cut to $48-52M FY guidance and the uniQure four-year data setback.

news.headline: Seeking Alpha author downgrades ClearPoint Neuro from speculative Buy to Hold
news.summary: Two days after the AMT-130 four-year readout, a previously bullish Seeking Alpha contributor admitted the speculative Buy call had not worked and moved CLPT to Hold. It reflects the sentiment reset: the stock now needs proof from its own numbers and the FDA's BLA acceptance rather than trading on uniQure optimism.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro shares fall 24% after uniQure AMT-130 four-year update
news.summary: CLPT dropped about 24% to roughly $11.77 and uniQure fell 55% after AMT-130 missed statistical significance on the primary cUHDRS comparison at 48 months. ClearPoint's navigation system and SmartFlow cannula deliver AMT-130, so the setback clouds the timing of its largest potential commercial delivery revenue stream.

news.headline: Partner uniQure's AMT-130 shows 44% slowing at four years, but miss on statistical significance
news.summary: High-dose AMT-130 patients showed a 44% slowing of cUHDRS decline versus the Enroll-HD comparator at four years, not statistically significant, while a post-hoc analysis versus an earlier control set showed a significant 54% slowing and Total Functional Capacity decline was a significant 61% slower. The 36-month analysis on 15 high-dose patients showed 80% cUHDRS slowing; the BLA filed September 2 still awaits an FDA acceptance decision in Q4 and the UK MAA has been validated.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings (Oct 28, after close): biologics back to growth and cash-burn check
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint reports Q3 2026 results on October 28 after the close, with a call at 4:30 p.m. ET. Management said the CAL preclinical facility, in its possession since July, should return the biologics and drug delivery segment (down 15% to $4.0M in Q2) to growth in Q3, making this the first test of whether the cut to $48-52M guidance was timing or demand. With cash at $29.4M against a roughly $10M quarterly operating loss, investors will also want commentary on funding needs and on how the AMT-130 four-year miss changes management's view of uniQure-related revenue timing. Consensus has drifted to about a $0.31 loss per share (TradingView preview, October 26), down from $0.26-0.27 earlier in October, with revenue estimates near $12.3M. That revenue bar still looks demanding after Q2's $10.9M print, which missed the ~$12.7M estimate.

catalysts.label: FDA 60-day filing review decides acceptance and Priority Review for the AMT-130 BLA
catalysts.detail: uniQure submitted the AMT-130 BLA on September 2, 2026 with a Priority Review request and still guides to an FDA acceptance decision in Q4 2026; the standard 60-day filing review ends around November 1. After the September 29 four-year readout missed statistical significance on the primary cUHDRS comparison, the acceptance call and any FDA comment on the 3-year primary basis are now the decisive checkpoint for the single most important program in ClearPoint's delivery-platform thesis.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA review of the AMT-130 Marketing Authorisation Application
catalysts.detail: uniQure's parallel MAA with the UK MHRA, filed September 2, 2026, has been validated and is now under review. A positive review would extend ClearPoint's delivery platform into a second, ex-US commercial channel alongside the US accelerated-approval pathway.

catalysts.label: Further partner BLA filings flagged on the Q2 call
catalysts.detail: Management stated on the August 3 call that multiple biopharma partners have recently received positive FDA feedback on potential BLA submissions and that additional cell and gene therapies should become commercially available by the end of 2027. Each partner filing beyond uniQure widens the base of recurring per-procedure delivery revenue and is the clearest way for ClearPoint to prove the platform thesis without depending on a single program.

catalysts.label: EpilepsyGTx EPY201 Phase 1/2a start
catalysts.detail: EpilepsyGTx announced in mid-July 2026 that it selected ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and navigation system for a first-in-human Phase I/IIa trial of EPY201 in focal refractory epilepsy, with the therapy slated to enter human studies in 2026. Trial initiation would convert the partnership announcement into actual procedure and service revenue and adds to the 10-15 trials management expects to be enrolling within 18 months.

catalysts.label: Aspen Neuroscience post-RMAT regulatory alignment
catalysts.detail: With RMAT designation granted on July 31, 2026 for sasineprocel (ANPD001), Aspen gains early and frequent FDA interactions and potential eligibility for priority review and accelerated approval for its autologous dopaminergic cell therapy in Parkinson's disease. An announced pivotal trial design or expanded ASPIRO enrollment would put a second approval pathway on ClearPoint hardware and lift procedure volumes ahead of any commercial launch.

catalysts.label: Partner trial ramp and roughly 10 data readouts
catalysts.detail: Management guided on the Q2 call to 10-15 clinical trials using ClearPoint technology enrolling patients over the next 18 months, plus roughly 10 partner data readouts. This is the core driver of the biologics and drug-delivery revenue line and the main evidence base needed to support the $500M long-term revenue ambition and the high-teens to 20% growth targeted for 2027.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 confirmatory Phase 3 trial start
catalysts.detail: The FDA's agreement to accept a BLA under accelerated approval is contingent on uniQure running a prospective, randomized confirmatory trial. Every dosing in that study would again require ClearPoint's navigation system and SmartFlow cannula, so trial initiation adds a multi-year stream of procedure and service revenue on top of any commercial launch volumes. Design details and timing have not been disclosed.

catalysts.label: First GLP IND-enabling study completed at CAL; robotics prototypes in preclinical use
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint signed its first GLP statement of work for the CAL facility, targeted for completion in 2027, and expects functioning cranial robot prototypes built around the KUKA LBR arm to be used preclinically at CAL and to generate incremental service revenue in 2027. Delivering both would prove out the capacity expansion from roughly $8M to over $60M in annual preclinical service capacity that underpins the new strategy.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA accelerated-approval decision on AMT-130
catalysts.detail: With the BLA filed September 2, 2026 and Priority Review requested, an FDA decision on the first Huntington's gene therapy could arrive as early as the first half of 2027 if Priority Review is granted, or in late 2027 under standard review. Approval would establish recurring per-procedure delivery revenue for ClearPoint and be the first commercial validation of the platform in a large chronic indication, following the Kebilidi precedent where SmartFlow is the only FDA-authorized delivery device.

pulse: CLPT is near the bottom of its $8.27-$30.10 52-week range after partner uniQure's AMT-130 four-year data missed statistical significance on September 29. Since then the only company-specific news is the October 14 earnings-date notice, and the consensus Q3 loss has widened to about $0.31 per share. The October 28 Q3 print is the immediate test: will biologics reaccelerate via the CAL facility, and can $29.4M of cash cover a roughly $10M quarterly operating loss? The FDA's 60-day acceptance decision on the AMT-130 BLA, due in early November, follows right after and sets the timeline for ClearPoint's largest delivery-revenue opportunity.
